notes.title: PRACTICE MODE!!!
notes.notes:
We added an experimental practice mode!

This is unlocked once you beat your first run.

notes.title: Small visual leaderboard update
notes.notes: - Updates the UI to fit better with more leaderboard entries

notes.title: Small QOL tweak
notes.notes:
- When a skin is unlocked, you can now update it during a run by exiting to main menu and applying it. 
- Fixed small issue with keybinds screen

notes.title: Achievement Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fixed bug where you would unlock 30 min time achievement on any finish.
